product_family: Enterprise AI platform for building, scaling, and governing AI applications across model development, MLOps, collaboration, and regulatory compliance. Includes Domino Platform, Domino Cloud (SaaS), Domino Nexus (multicloud), and Domino Governance (policy enforcement).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Data Lab Achieves ISO 9001:2015 Certification, and SOC 2 Type II Compliance with Zero Findings. Achievement Date: September 16, 2025. Audit Result: Zero findings (strongest possible outcome).

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Data Lab maintains a risk-based security and quality program aligned with ISO 27001 and ISO 9001. Our governance framework includes formal oversight, documented controls, continuous monitoring, and independent external audits. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification current.

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Data Lab Achieves ISO 9001:2015 Certification, and SOC 2 Type II Compliance with Zero Findings. Achievement Date: September 16, 2025. Internationally recognized quality management system standard that ensures consistent delivery of products and services meeting enterprise and regulatory requirements.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Cloud is GDPR compliant. Domino Cloud achieved GDPR compliance as of October 2023. The platform provides mechanisms for submitting General Data Protection Regulation requests, enabling organizations to fulfill their obligations as data controllers under GDPR regulations.

certifications.name: HIPAA (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Cloud is HIPAA compliant. Achieved October 2023. John Brunn, Domino's CISO, emphasizes that HIPAA compliance ensures sensitive patient health information (PHI) is secure and patient privacy will always be protected. Single-tenant SaaS within dedicated infrastructure with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2 in transit.

certifications.name: FIPS 140-2
certifications.proof_quote: Domino Cloud achieved FIPS certification in their 5.11 release to support federal customers meeting FIPS standards while developing AI models with sensitive data. FIPS-compliant solutions employ robust encryption techniques to safeguard confidential information from unauthorized access.

certifications.name: GxP (Good Practice Guidelines for regulated industries)
certifications.proof_quote: Domino is deployed in a DoD IL5 environment and delivers the traceability and governance required for GxP processes. Platform is deployed in environments with DISA STIG and DoD IL5 requirements, is contracted for IL6 deployments.

certifications.name: 21 CFR Part 11 (FDA pharmaceutical compliance)
certifications.proof_quote: The platform supports compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 (FDA pharmaceutical regulations), EudraLex (European pharmaceutical regulations), and WHO Annex 5 (World Health Organization guidelines).

privacy.privacy_policy_url: https://domino.ai/ (referenced in footer; full legal URL not publicly listed but accessible via website)
privacy.ai_training_note: No evidence that Domino trains on customer data. Platform is designed for regulated industries (life sciences, finance, public sector) where data protection is critical. Search results indicate: 'The platform addresses risks where private data may leak through careless use in model training,' suggesting Domino provides governance tools to prevent data leakage rather than training on customer data themselves. Domino Governance solution allows customers to manage and enforce policies across the AI lifecycle.
privacy.data_region: Single-tenant SaaS: each customer resides in their own AWS VPC and subaccount. Supports regional access restrictions and local data processing via Domino Nexus for data sovereignty requirements.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encrypted with KMS (Key Management Service)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 for data in motion; Istio service mesh for intra-cluster encryption in transit when enabled via CA certificates

security.name: Network Isolation
security.value: Single-tenant architecture: each customer resides in dedicated AWS subaccount and within their own VPC; no data mixing across deployments

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Granular role-based access control (RBAC); corporate SSO credential integration; Kubernetes pod security contexts

security.name: Testing & Validation
security.value: Code reviews, SAST (static application security testing), DAST (dynamic application security testing), third-party penetration testing

security.name: Monitoring & Audit
security.value: Vulnerability assessments, security monitoring with third-party auditing, regular patching, data backups; full traceability of code, models, data, and environments for experiment recreation and compliance documentation

security.name: Government Deployment Support
security.value: Deployed in DoD IL5 environments; contracted for IL6 deployments; approved solution in Iron Bank (Navy container registry); supports FISMA, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP requirements

products.name: Domino Platform
products.data_scope: On-premises or customer-managed cloud deployments; full control over data residency
products.notes: Core platform for building AI systems and applications. Model factory for development, App Hub for scaling to users, Governance Center for compliance. Supports model factory, app deployment, and governance.

products.name: Domino Cloud
products.data_scope: Single-tenant AWS infrastructure (customer-specific VPC); regional isolation support
products.notes: GDPR and HIPAA compliant SaaS deployment option. October 2023 compliance achievement. Includes governance features, full traceability, and compliance automation.

products.name: Domino Nexus
products.data_scope: Supports multicloud and hybrid deployments; regional data residency and local processing
products.notes: Single pane of glass for multicloud and hybrid data science. Enables data sovereignty and local processing requirements.

products.name: Domino Governance
products.notes: Policy management and enforcement for the full AI lifecycle. Embeds compliance checks and automates audit readiness. Helps prevent private data leakage in model training.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS with seat-based and usage-based options; custom on-premises licensing available
compare.data_residency: Single-tenant SaaS (customer VPC isolation); on-premises deployment option available for full data control. Supports regional access restrictions and local processing via Domino Nexus.
